text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS13, 6" Oiled Bronze Pineapple Door Knocker

The 6 Inch Oiled Bronze Palm Springs Pineapple Door Knocker is a great way to add a bit of the retro-glam decor that is iconic of Palm Springs. This Hospitality Pineapple Knocker in Oiled Bronze is easy to install and comes packaged with everything you'll need to surface mount it to your front door. It was designed by Michael Healy and displays an attention to detail that makes it a beautiful statement piece for your front door.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also Available larger 8-1/2" Oiled Bronze Pineapple Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Pineapple Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 2-13/16" at widest part
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 3-3/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 3 finishes:
Oiled Bronze Brass Nickel Silver

Sold Individually
